name: collection-sciencemuseumgroup
description: Science Museum Group Collection (collection.sciencemuseumgroup.org.uk), the online catalogue of over 500,000 museum objects and archives. This CLI reads only the public homepage: featured collections, top-level collection categories, and 'on this day' anniversary highlights.

commands.name: list-featured-collections
commands.summary: List the featured collections shown in the homepage 'Explore' carousel (for example BBC Heritage Collection), with title, description and link

commands.name: list-collection-categories
commands.summary: List the top-level collection themes on the homepage (for example Medicine), with their description and subcategory text (for example Pharmacology, Surgery, Asian medicine)

commands.name: list-anniversaries
commands.summary: List the homepage 'anniversary' highlights: collection objects linked to events from N years ago today, with the anniversary text and a link to the object

notes: Only the homepage could be loaded. Every request for keyword search (/search?q=...), category listings (/search/categories/...), object pages (/objects/{id}) and archive documents (/documents/{id}), including their ?ajax=true variants, got a CloudFront 403 'Request blocked' from the site's bot/WAF protection.

No search or detail commands are provided for three reasons: the recorded responses were 403 errors, the site's robots.txt disallows /api/, /iiif/, /mcp and any URL with a query string, and working around the bot block would not be appropriate.
The homepage returns curated, rotating content. Carousel items and anniversary cards change over time.
The 'url' fields point to collection, category or object pages on the site. These are links for a human to open. Fetching them programmatically is expected to be blocked.
For programmatic access to collection data, contact the Science Museum Group about official data or API access instead of scraping.
